hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty' | grep -qE '(config/ktlint/baseline|detekt-baseline)\.xml$' && { echo 'Blocked: lint baselines are only regenerated deliberately via ./gradlew ktlintGenerateBaseline detektBaseline — fix the violation instead.' >&2; exit 2; } || exit 0

jq -e '(.tool_input.file_path // "" | endswith("composeApp/build.gradle.kts")) and ((.tool_input.new_string // .tool_input.content // "") | test("versionCode|versionName"))' >/dev/null && { echo 'Reminder: versionCode/versionName changed — iosApp/iosApp/Info.plist (CFBundleVersion/CFBundleShortVersionString) must be bumped too; they are not linked.' >&2; exit 2; } || exit 0
